note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are copied into a stack buffer and NUL-terminated for demangling.
The fuzz input length is passed as the output buffer size, so the demangler may write/read using a size derived from attacker-controlled input.

The implementation only checks the overflow flag after parsing; if parsing consumes a malformed mangled name path that reads past the stack buffer, the safety obligation that parsing stay within the input string is violated.
